description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Upgrade the Java runtime from 1.8 to 17 LTS to resolve the end-of-support Java version and ensure compatibility with the modern Azure SDK.
tasks.reason: Java 1.8 has reached end of support. Upgrading to Java 17 LTS provides long-term security patches, modern language features, and is required for compatibility with the modern com.azure SDK and other up-to-date dependencies.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade the project Java source and target from 1.8 to 17 in pom.xml (maven-compiler-plugin configuration). Ensure the project compiles and all existing tests pass under Java 17. Addresses issues: 'Java Version Has Reached the End of Support'.
tasks.taskSummary: Upgraded Java compiler source and target from 1.8 to 17 in pom.xml; updated maven-compiler-plugin from 3.8.1 to 3.11.0. Project compiles and tests pass under JDK 17.

tasks.description: Migrate the project from the legacy Azure SDK for Java (com.microsoft.azure.*) to the modern Azure SDK for Java (com.azure.*), replacing deprecated credential management, REST client setup, resource group interceptors, and file-based authentication.
tasks.reason: The legacy com.microsoft.azure:azure SDK has reached end of support and will not receive security or feature updates. Migration to the modern com.azure track-2 SDK ensures continued support, improved authentication via DefaultAzureCredential, and better cloud-native patterns.
tasks.requirements: Replace all com.microsoft.azure.* imports and usages with com.azure.* equivalents in all source files. This includes: replacing ApplicationTokenCredentials with DefaultAzureCredential or ClientSecretCredential; replacing RestClient.Builder with HttpClient builder patterns from the modern SDK; updating the ResourceGroupTaggingInterceptor to use modern HTTP pipeline policies; replacing AzureJacksonAdapter with modern serialization; replacing Azure.authenticate() and Azure.configure() with AzureResourceManager from com.azure.resourcemanager; updating pom.xml to remove com.microsoft.azure:azure and add com.azure:azure-resourcemanager and com.azure.identity:azure-identity; resolving file-based credential loading (java.io.File) by using DefaultAzureCredential or environment-variable-based credential chain instead. Addresses issues: 'Legacy Azure SDKs for Java (com.microsoft.azure.*) reached the end of support', 'File system - Java IO', 'Environment variables/system properties'.
tasks.taskSummary: Migrated all com.microsoft.azure.* usages to com.azure.* equivalents. Replaced ApplicationTokenCredentials with ClientSecretCredential, RestClient.Builder with AzureResourceManager.configure(), ResourceGroupTaggingInterceptor with HttpPipelinePolicy, removed legacy SDK from pom.xml and added azure-resourcemanager and azure-identity. Build and tests pass with zero legacy imports remaining.

tasks.description: Scan all project dependencies for known CVEs and remediate any identified vulnerabilities to ensure the application is secure.
tasks.reason: Dependencies such as commons-net 3.3, commons-lang 2.6, commons-lang3 3.7, and jsch 0.1.55 are outdated and may contain known CVEs. Remediating vulnerabilities ensures the application meets security compliance standards.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade vulnerable dependencies to the minimum patched version. If a CVE fix requires a major version upgrade, document the affected dependency, the current version, the upgraded major version, and the breaking change risk. Verify that the project builds and all tests pass after remediation.
tasks.taskSummary: Fixed 9 CVEs across 3 dependency upgrades: io.netty BOM 4.1.132→4.1.133 (7 CVEs), commons-net 3.3→3.11.1 (1 CVE), commons-lang3 3.7→3.18.0 (1 CVE). Build and tests pass. jsch 0.1.55 has no Maven Central fix; migration to com.github.mwiede:jsch documented as follow-up.
